rows = get_rows('supp.xlsx','Sheet1')
hdr = rows[0]
# community evaluable patients provide assay backing (Table S4); outcomes/predictions from Figure 4B (vision refs)
treat = [
 "WCB015_FOLFOX","WCB015_FOLFIRIBev","WCB015_TAS102",
 "WCB027_Capecitabine","WCB027_XELOX",
 "WCB041_Capecitabine","WCB041_FOLFIRIBev",
 "WCB087_5FU","WCB091_FOLFOXBev",
 "WCB123_FOLFOX","WCB123_FOLFOXIRI",
 "WCB139_5FUBev","WCB139_TAS102",
 "WCB146_5FUBev",
 "WCB150_5FUBev","WCB150_FOLFIRI","WCB150_TAS102",
 "WCB203_CapeBev","WCB203_Irinotecan",
 "WCB217_TAS102","WCB221_FOLFOX",
 "WCB239_FOLFOXBev","WCB239_FOLFIRICetux",
 "WCB242_FOLFIRIPani",
 "WCB245_FOLFOXCetux",
 "WCB254_FOLFOXIRI","WCB254_FOLFOXCetux",
 "WCB291_5FUBev","WCB296_FOLFOXIRI",
]
assert len(treat)==29
records=[]
for t in treat:
    records.append({
        "id": t,
        "score": {"ref": "vision/%s_pred"%t, "map": {"Sensitive":1,"Resistant":0}, "threshold":0.5, "op":">="},
        "truth": {"ref": "vision/%s_resp"%t, "map": {"Good response":1,"Poor response":0}},
    })
# sanity check against published confusion counts using recorded label values
lab = {
 "WCB015_FOLFOX":(0,0),"WCB015_FOLFIRIBev":(0,0),"WCB015_TAS102":(0,0),
 "WCB027_Capecitabine":(0,0),"WCB027_XELOX":(1,1),
 "WCB041_Capecitabine":(0,0),"WCB041_FOLFIRIBev":(1,1),
 "WCB087_5FU":(0,0),"WCB091_FOLFOXBev":(1,1),
 "WCB123_FOLFOX":(1,1),"WCB123_FOLFOXIRI":(0,1),
 "WCB139_5FUBev":(0,1),"WCB139_TAS102":(0,0),
 "WCB146_5FUBev":(1,1),
 "WCB150_5FUBev":(0,0),"WCB150_FOLFIRI":(0,0),"WCB150_TAS102":(0,0),
 "WCB203_CapeBev":(1,1),"WCB203_Irinotecan":(1,1),
 "WCB217_TAS102":(0,1),"WCB221_FOLFOX":(1,1),
 "WCB239_FOLFOXBev":(1,0),"WCB239_FOLFIRICetux":(1,1),
 "WCB242_FOLFIRIPani":(0,0),
 "WCB245_FOLFOXCetux":(0,1),
 "WCB254_FOLFOXIRI":(0,0),"WCB254_FOLFOXCetux":(0,0),
 "WCB291_5FUBev":(0,0),"WCB296_FOLFOXIRI":(1,1),
}
acc = sum(1 for t in treat if lab[t][0]==lab[t][1])/29.0
tp = sum(1 for t in treat if lab[t][0]==1 and lab[t][1]==1)
fn = sum(1 for t in treat if lab[t][0]==0 and lab[t][1]==1)
tn = sum(1 for t in treat if lab[t][0]==0 and lab[t][1]==0)
fp = sum(1 for t in treat if lab[t][0]==1 and lab[t][1]==0)
print("acc",acc,"TP",tp,"FP",fp,"FN",fn,"TN",tn,"sens",tp/(tp+fn),"spec",tn/(tn+fp))
